summary: National rugby union team of New Zealand, known for its black kit and for performing a haka before matches. It has won the Rugby World Cup three times and has one of the best win records in international sport.

events.note: Dated from New Zealand's first Test match, in 1903. A national team first toured in 1884, and the name All Blacks dates from the tour of 1905.
